anomaly_signals.detail: 619 errors out of 1000 spans — 61.9% error rate. Likely propagating failures from downstream services, acting as a primary blast radius amplifier.
256 errors out of 1000 spans — 25.6% error rate. Elevated failures correlating with postgres-auth degradation.
200 errors out of 483 spans — 41.4% error rate. Aligns with 203 recorded genai_tool_failures, indicating widespread tool execution breakdown likely tied to the memory incident.
192 errors out of 496 spans — 38.7% error rate. Agent orchestration heavily impacted, consistent with memory/tool pipeline failures.
93 errors out of 496 spans — 18.8% error rate. Core component of the active memory_incident scenario; failures propagate upstream to agent-service and tool-executor.
128 errors out of 384 spans — 33.3% error rate. Significant payment processing failures; postgres-payments (86/384, 22.4%) likely contributing.
121 errors out of 1000 spans — 12.1% error rate. Database-level auth failures driving auth-service degradation.
94 errors out of 864 spans — 10.9% error rate. 28 token truncation events detected, suggesting context window overflow possibly caused by bloated memory context being injected into prompts.
p99 latency of 26,064.9 ms (~26 seconds) across the batch indicates severe end-to-end slowdowns, consistent with memory fetch bottlenecks and tool execution timeouts.

recommended_action: Immediately investigate and isolate the memory-service: restart or roll back the degraded instance, as its failures are cascading into tool-executor (41% error rate), agent-service (39%), and inflating LLM context (causing token truncations). Simultaneously, check postgres-auth replication lag to stabilize auth-service, and throttle payment traffic until postgres-payments recovers. Validate LLM prompt construction to prevent oversized memory context payloads reaching llm-gemini.
summary: A confirmed memory_incident is causing a broad systemic outage: 24.1% of all spans are in error and p99 latency has blown out to ~26 seconds. The memory-service failure is cascading through tool-executor and agent-service, driving 203 GenAI tool failures and 28 token truncations, while api-gateway is absorbing the highest raw error volume (619 errors) as the downstream blast radius amplifier.
